newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 30.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 30.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Monday, despite storms off the Pacific Coast, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Along the Baja California coast winds from 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) with waves four to seven feet high. Rains expected and weaker wind gusts along the rest of the coast.
A tropical depression at 215 miles of the Socorro Island in the Pacific Ocean moving west-northwest with winds of 25 to 35 knots (47 to 56 km/27 to 38 miles per hour) and waves eight to 12 feet high.
Light rains in Veracruz, and winds in general from 10 to 15 (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) with waves three to six feet high.
Strong tropical winds and electric storms along coast of Quintana Roo state, Honduras and Nicaragua. Winds from 10 to 15 knots and waves four to seven feet high.
